text: Every setting Power BI uses to connect to this platform was actually decided back in Chapter 2 — this lesson is just the first time an actual BI tool uses them.
The warehouse is reporting_wh, never the one dbt builds with. The schema is prod, never raw, never dev. The role is analyst, read-only, nothing more.
PROD contains only customers and orders, the two marts that have already passed every test and the CI gate. Connecting to DEV instead would expose a developer's half-finished work to business users.
Analyst can only select from prod — no write access anywhere, no visibility into raw or dev, and it runs on its own warehouse so a report refresh never competes with a dbt build for compute.

A business user building a visual never sees any of this — the governance is invisible from inside Power BI, which is the point. Next: watching this platform's real CI gate catch a genuine production incident.
